identity.name: Signal Stack AI
identity.tagline: The AI news archive that shows what changed and who said what when.

include: Long-form news, analysis, interviews, and livestreams on the official channel
exclude: Shorts that only excerpt an indexed long-form source
exceptions: Owner-approved guest appearances may enter a separate source lane

sourceLanes.label: Briefings
sourceLanes.purpose: Canonical long-form AI news and analysis.
sourceLanes.inclusionRule: Published on the official channel and primarily about AI technology, companies, research, policy, or business.

sourceLanes.label: Field Reports
sourceLanes.inclusionRule: Explicitly approved by the owner and includes a substantial contribution from a listed creator.

entities.label: Company
entities.definition: An AI company, platform owner, or relevant institution.

entities.label: Model
entities.definition: A named model or stable model family.

entities.label: Product
entities.definition: A user-facing AI product, API, or service.

entities.label: Person
entities.definition: A canonical host, guest, researcher, executive, or public official.

relationships.label: Discusses
relationships.definition: A bounded receipt explicitly discusses the entity.

relationships.label: Compares
relationships.definition: A bounded receipt explicitly compares at least two entities.

relationships.label: Follows Up
relationships.definition: A later bounded receipt explicitly revisits an earlier documented subject or claim.

receipts.label: Launch Signal
receipts.definition: A bounded discussion of a specific launch or release.

receipts.label: Claim
receipts.definition: A bounded, attributable assertion made in the indexed source.

receipts.label: Forecast
receipts.definition: A bounded statement about a future, testable outcome.

receipts.label: Explainer
receipts.definition: A bounded segment that explains a concept or consequence.

structuredLedgers.label: Launch Ledger
structuredLedgers.definition: Reviewed launch dates, products, companies, versions, and source receipts.

structuredLedgers.label: Claim Watch
structuredLedgers.definition: Strong claims, predictions, later evidence, and unresolved state.

evidencePolicy.speakerPolicy: Do not identify a speaker from undiarized captions alone.

principles: Separate what was said then from what is true now

visualWorld.metaphor: A live intelligence desk connected to an experimental model lab.
visualWorld.recognitionTest: Without the logo, the first screen must read as a live AI intelligence desk, not a generic technology blog.

completeArchive.label: The Complete Briefing Archive
completeArchive.job: Browse every canonical show by date, company, model, product, and subject.
completeArchive.interaction: Filterable archive with source dossiers and exact playback.
completeArchive.evidence: Canonical source registry and source-scoped receipts.

fanFrontDoors.label: What Changed This Week
fanFrontDoors.job: See the meaningful additions and corrections across recent shows.
fanFrontDoors.interaction: A dated change board with playable source signals.
fanFrontDoors.evidence: Reviewed launch, claim, correction, and comparison receipts.

fanFrontDoors.label: Model Time Machine
fanFrontDoors.job: Follow coverage of one model or company across time.
fanFrontDoors.interaction: Chronological receipt path with version and source filters.
fanFrontDoors.evidence: Entity-resolved, bounded receipts ordered by publication date.

fanFrontDoors.label: Ask the Briefing Room
fanFrontDoors.job: Answer archive questions and play the support.
fanFrontDoors.interaction: Structured answer followed by a two-to-six-stop playable trail.
fanFrontDoors.evidence: Structured ledgers first, then related receipts, then source-scoped transcript corroboration.

creatorTools.label: Research Desk
creatorTools.job: Prepare a model, company, or launch packet before recording.
creatorTools.interaction: Generate a source-linked briefing with prior coverage, open claims, and gaps.
creatorTools.evidence: Canonical entities, ledgers, corrections, and exact receipts.

creatorTools.label: Clip Radar
creatorTools.job: Find timely, standalone explanations and consequential claims.
creatorTools.interaction: Review ranked edit plans with exact windows and risk labels.
creatorTools.evidence: Bounded receipts plus an explicitly non-archival edit proposal.

signatureMechanics.label: Claim Watch
signatureMechanics.job: Track a documented forecast without inventing an outcome.
signatureMechanics.interaction: Open, supported, contradicted, mixed, and unresolved claim dockets.
signatureMechanics.evidence: Reviewed before/after receipts and an append-only adjudication record.

signatureMechanics.label: Launch Room
signatureMechanics.job: Understand one launch across initial report, analysis, comparison, and correction.
signatureMechanics.interaction: An interactive briefing wall centered on a reviewed launch ledger.

returnRitual.label: Weekly Signal Drop
returnRitual.job: Give fans a recurring reason to return.
returnRitual.interaction: A weekly playable path through the most consequential new archive additions.
returnRitual.evidence: Newly promoted receipts with visible dates and review state.

riskRules: Recheck time-sensitive facts at edit time.
Do not present a host prediction as fact.
Keep promotional copy separate from archival wording.
Hold candidates with ambiguous speaker identity.

updateContract.cadence: Within two business days of each approved long-form upload.
updateContract.sourceOfTruth: The official channel feed plus owner-approved guest sources.
